description: Imports all media files from a folder into the current Premiere Pro project. Target a nested bin with binId (a bin nodeId, unambiguous — preferred, e.g. straight from create_bin) or binName, which also accepts a "/"-separated path. An unresolvable or ambiguous bin fails before anything is imported; the bin actually used is reported back.

binId.description: Destination bin nodeId — the unambiguous way to target a nested bin. Takes precedence over binName.

binName.description: Destination bin by name. Use a "/"-separated path ("Scenes/Scene 008/SC008_0710") for a nested bin, or a single name to deep-search the tree (ambiguous single names are rejected). Omit to import to the project root.

folderPath.description: The absolute path to the folder containing media files

recursive.description: Whether to import from subfolders recursively

name: import_folder
